flags.why: This is mainly Southern usage, whereas the Northern form is thi đỗ, as distinguished in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/thi_%C4%91%E1%BA%ADu).
The example defines the word instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Trong giờ thiên văn, chúng tôi học cách xác định vị trí các sao trên thiên cầu. = In astronomy class, we learned how to locate stars on the celestial sphere.

flags.why: Thiên di is a formal or literary term rather than a neutral word for everyday conversation.
The Vietnamese says that nobody is treated differently, while the English adds a recommendation with should.
flags.fix: No one is treated differently because of their sexual orientation.

flags.why: Thiên lí meaning a great distance or long road is literary rather than ordinary conversational vocabulary.
